svg.title: QZcode: a coding pipeline split across three models
svg.desc: Left: name, one-line value and three hard rules. Right: the loop of one run — A writes the brief, B implements, C verifies read-only; a failed verdict sends the issues back to A.
svg.text: L ROUTES · A BRIEFS · B BUILDS · C VERIFIES

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three models that check each other —

svg.text: instead of grading their own work.
